steps.name: fresh-main-and-python-regressions
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
git status --short
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin main
git checkout -B main origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "5442848ba697f4a669ad300c31bda3b87f41d66a"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -t scripts -p 'test_*.py'
echo PYTHON_UNITTTESTS_OK=true

steps.name: gradle-build-and-tests
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
bash scripts/local_agent/host_verify.sh
echo HOST_VERIFY_GREEN=true

steps.name: wireless-adb-read-only-preflight
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'phone_probe=non_dialing\n'
bash scripts/local_agent/device_readiness.sh
printf 'phone_ready=true\n'
